description: This file is a JavaScript plugin module for FooTable v3, a jQuery plugin that manages table state (filtering, paging, sorting) persistence using localStorage. It defines the FooTable.State component, methods for reading, writing, and clearing state, and integrates with FooTable's lifecycle hooks.

classes.name: FooTable.State
classes.description: A component that manages the persistence of table state (filtering, paging, sorting) using localStorage, with methods to get, set, remove, read, write, and clear state.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves stored state data for a given key from localStorage.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores state data for a given key into localStorage.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes stored state data for a given key from localStorage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Triggers all components to read their stored state.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Triggers all components to write their current state to storage.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored state data for the table.

methods.name: _uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for the table instance based on URL hash and element ID.
